scripts.postinstall: npm --workspace packages/db run generate && node -e "if(process.env.VERCEL!=='1'){require('child_process').execSync('npm --workspace packages/db run migrate:deploy',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('Skipping migrate:deploy on Vercel (run db:migrate manually)')}"
scripts.db:migrate: npm --workspace packages/db run prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm --workspace packages/db run prisma db seed
